digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing / rebar comment command
propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-looking tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, destroying the intended content while exiting 0
the command's exit code and lack of stderr make the loss undetectable until downstream gates that read comment content fail for missing attestations
positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) need a guard that rejects arguments beginning with - unless escaped with --
the -- escape hatch must be documented and tested to allow comment bodies that legitimately start with a dash
two independent sessions have lost multi-KB work records due to this footgun, making it a durability defect affecting the ticket store's reliability as the primary durable trail
